jagatai.definition: n a Turkic literary language of medieval central Asia (named for one of the sons of Genghis Khan)

jager.definition:
n. A sharpshooter. See Yager.
n. Any species of gull of the genus Stercorarius. Three species
   occur on the Atlantic coast. The jagers pursue other species of gulls
   and force them to disgorge their prey. The two middle tail feathers are
   usually decidedly longer than the rest. Called also boatswain, and
   marline-spike bird. The name is also applied to the skua, or Arctic
   gull (Megalestris skua).

jager's diplococcus.translation: [医] 耶格氏双球菌, 肥双球菌

jaguar.definition: n. a large spotted feline of tropical America similar to the leopard; in some classifications considered a member of the genus Felis

jaguarondi.definition:
n. A South American wild cat (Felis jaguarondi), having a
   long, slim body and very short legs. Its color is grayish brown, varied
   with a blackish hue. It is arboreal in its habits and feeds mostly on
   birds.
